aboutPage.heroDesc: Authorized overseas sample factory of Shanghai WISER Machinery Co., Ltd. and strategic partner of Sidefu Linen.
aboutPage.sec1Desc: Established in Shanghai, China, Shanghai WISER Machinery Co., Ltd. is a premier manufacturer of industrial laundry systems, soft-mount high-extract washers, chest flatwork ironers, and automatic folders with CE, ISO 9001, and ISO 14001 certifications.
aboutPage.sec1Point2: Microcomputer Smart PLC touchscreen with 30+ programmable formulas
aboutPage.sec1Point3: Heavy-gauge SUS 304/316L stainless steel inner and outer drums
aboutPage.sec1Point4: Direct steam, thermal oil, and electric high-efficiency heating systems
aboutPage.sec2Desc: Founded in 1984, Sidefu is one of the world's most prestigious luxury hotel linen manufacturers, serving top global brands including Marriott, Hilton, InterContinental, Hyatt, and Kempinski with OEKO-TEX 100 Class 1 certified textiles.
aboutPage.sec2Point1: 100% Long-Staple Combed Cotton (300T to 1000T Sateen & Percale)
aboutPage.sec2Point2: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class 1 certification (Safe for infant skin)
aboutPage.sec2Point3: Engineered for 300+ commercial wash durability without fiber degradation
aboutPage.sec2Point4: Complete guest room sets: Bed sheets, duvet covers, plush towels & bathrobes
aboutPage.timeline1Desc: Establishment of dedicated manufacturing plant in Shanghai focusing on heavy-duty commercial laundry equipment.
aboutPage.timeline2Desc: Full compliance achieved for EU Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and international quality management standards.
aboutPage.timeline3Desc: Alliance forged with Sidefu China to provide turnkey synchronized equipment and luxury linen solutions.
aboutPage.timeline4Desc: WISER ACC establishes modernized overseas demonstration and engineering support facilities for international clients.
aboutPage.ctaTitle: Ready to Plan Your Turnkey Laundry Facility?
aboutPage.ctaDesc: Consult directly with our factory engineers for equipment sizing, CAD plant floorplans, and official wholesale quotations.
aboutPage.wiserDesc1: Shanghai WISER (www.shweishi.com) is a preeminent Chinese manufacturer specializing in heavy-duty commercial washers, automated ironing systems, and tunnel washing technology.
aboutPage.wiserDesc2: WISER ACC operates as the official sample factory and exclusive overseas trademark operating center of WISER Group. All machinery is built under certified ISO9001 quality management and conforms to European CE safety directives, featuring authentic WISER trademarking and German-inspired engineering tolerances.
aboutPage.sidefuDesc1: Sidefu China (www.sidefu-china.com) is the trusted textile provider for the world's most prestigious hospitality chains, including Marriott, InterContinental, Hilton, and Kempinski.
aboutPage.sidefuDesc2: Through WISER ACC, clients gain direct access to certified Sidefu hotel bed linens, duvet covers, plush 650 GSM bath towels, and F&B table textiles specifically woven to withstand 300+ commercial wash cycles while preserving luxury softness and whiteness.
aboutPage.qa1Desc: Every washer drum is tested at full speed up to 350G extraction force with high-precision laser vibration sensors to ensure lifetime stability.
aboutPage.qa2Desc: All steam cylinders and chests undergo 1.5x hydrostatic pressure testing to guarantee zero leaks and maximum heat transfer.
aboutPage.qa3Desc: Hospitality fabrics are verified for shrinkage (<3%), warp/weft tear strength (>450N), and chlorine color fastness.

solutionsPage.heroTitle: Turnkey Laundry Solutions for Every Scale
solutionsPage.heroDesc: From on-premise luxury resort laundries to 30-ton/day automated industrial central plants and healthcare-certified cleanroom bio-barriers.
solutionsPage.sol1Desc: Eliminate linen damage and delivery delays with an optimized on-premise laundry. Paired with certified Sidefu bed sheets and bath towels, this solution ensures 5-star guest satisfaction, flawless mirror ironing, and maximum fiber lifespan.
solutionsPage.sol1Feat1: Synchronized 350G washer extractors and energy-efficient tumble dryers
solutionsPage.sol1Feat2: Mirror-polished chest flatwork ironer for pristine sheet finishes
solutionsPage.sol1Feat3: OEKO-TEX 100 certified Sidefu 600T–800T combed cotton linens
solutionsPage.sol1Feat4: Complete CAD pipe routing, steam boiler integration & chemical dosing layout
solutionsPage.sol2Desc: Strict infection control requires physical partition between contaminated soiled receiving and sterile clean dispatch. Our pass-through barrier washers meet ISO 14644 cleanroom standards and perform thermal disinfection at 85°C+.
solutionsPage.sol2Feat1: Dual-door physical partition barrier isolating contaminated and clean zones
solutionsPage.sol2Feat2: Automated thermal disinfection cycle maintaining 90°C+ wash profiles
solutionsPage.sol2Feat3: SUS 316L acid/alkali-resistant medical grade stainless steel inner drums
solutionsPage.sol2Feat4: HEPA-filtered cleanroom tumble dryers and hygienic bagging dispatch
solutionsPage.sol3Desc: Engineered for central commercial laundry factories processing 10 to 50 tons per day. Combines heavy washer extractors or continuous batch tunnel washers with automated ironing lines, shuttle dryers, and sorting conveyors.
solutionsPage.sol3Feat1: Heavy-duty 100kg washer extractor batteries with pneumatic tilt unloading
solutionsPage.sol3Feat2: Multi-roll gas/steam flatwork ironers paired with 4-lane high-speed folders
solutionsPage.sol3Feat3: Integrated wastewater heat recovery reducing steam consumption up to 40%
solutionsPage.sol3Feat4: Centralized RFID tracking and plant-wide SCADA automation monitoring
solutionsPage.ctaTitle: Need a Custom Turnkey Plant Proposal?
solutionsPage.ctaDesc: Share your daily linen targets and floor dimensions with our engineering team for a customized CAD layout and ROI audit.
solutionsPage.dom1Desc: Soft-mount washers + mirror flatwork ironers + Sidefu linens
solutionsPage.sol1Point1: Soft-mount vibration absorbing washers (safe for upper floor installations)
solutionsPage.sol1Point2: Mirror-polished flatwork ironers with automated lane folding
solutionsPage.sol1Point3: Sidefu 5-star linen package included (sheets, duvets, 650 GSM towels)
solutionsPage.sol2Point1: 100% Hermetic wall partition seal preventing airborne bacteria transfer
solutionsPage.sol2Point2: Thermal chemical disinfection cycle with full data logging PLC
solutionsPage.sol2Point3: Meets European RABC (Risk Analysis & Biocontamination Control) standards
solutionsPage.sol3Point1: Ultra-low water consumption (~4.5 liters per kg of linen)
solutionsPage.sol3Point2: High-speed 35 m/min ironing lines with automatic 4-lane sheet stackers
solutionsPage.sol3Point3: Centralized chemical dosing and heat recovery boiler integration
